NEW SUBTYPE: SPYRER

There are a number of special rules that apply to a Spyrer:

Kill Count: Each Spyrer hunting rig records all that happens to the Spyrer, verifying their kills and unlocking functions of the hunting rig and its weaponry as their Kill Count ticks up, making them an ever more dangerous foe. In addition to gaining XP, each time a Spyrer takes an enemy Fighter Out of Action, increase the Spyrer’s Kill Count by 1.

Threat Assessment: When selecting starting Crews or Reinforcement, divide the number of models allowed by two, rounding up, to determine the number of Spyrers that may be selected. For example, if 3 Reinforcements would arrive, only two Spyrers arrive.

Master of the Hunt: All Spyrers have a suite of special rules granted to them by their hunting rigs:

  • All Spyrers have the Juggernaut skill.
  • A Spyrer may never be Captured for any reason; rather, they are considered to have suffered Superficial Damage.
  • Spyrers do not suffer side effects from chems and can never become addicted to them.
  • A Spyrer never needs to make Nerve check.

Reflex Enhancers: During the Ready Gang step of the Priority Phase, all Spyrers gain one extra Ready marker; if an effect would prevent them from gaining a Ready marker, they gain one fewer Ready marker. Each time a Spyrer activates, they only remove one Ready marker – this means they will be able to activate twice each round. Any effect that removes Ready markers or prevents them from being added only affects one Ready marker.

SPYRER POST CYCLE ACTIONS

Spyrers do not have access to the standard Post-cycle Actions; instead, they may only perform the following Post-cycle Actions:

SUIT EVOLUTION (SPYRER ONLY)

If a Spyrer’s Kill Count is at least 4, reduce their Kill Count by 4, and either clear all Spyrer Hunting Rig Glitches (resetting their Glitch Count to zero and removing all negative effects caused by the Glitches), or gain a Hunting Rig Augmentation as follows. If the Spyrer’s Kill Count is still at least 4, they may perform this action again for free.

Hunting Rig Augmentation: The hunting rig improves the power supply to one of its systems and brings additional functions online. Pick one weapon or piece of wargear carried by the Spyrer and increased its Augmentation tier by 1. If the new Augmentation would increase a characteristic beyond its maximum increase the Augmentation tier by an additional 1.

SUIT MAINTENANCE (SPYRER ONLY)

The Fighter repairs and maintains their hunting rig. The gang can remove 100 credits from their Stash in order to clear all Spyrer Hunting Rig Glitches (resetting their Glitch Count to zero and removing all negative effects cause by the glitches).

TERRORISE TERRITORY (SPYRER ONLY – MAX FIVE FIGHTERS)

The Spyrer goes out into a Territory, subduing the local populace and flushing out any Aranthian sympathizers. Add 10 credits to the gang’s Stash for each Spyrer that performs this action.

TRAIN (SPYRER ONLY)

The Spyrer practises their skills ready for the upcoming battles. Each Spyrer that performs this action earns 2 XP.

SPYRER HUNTING RIG GLITCHES

D66Lasting Injury
11Lesson Learnt: The Spyrer earn D3 XP.
12Eternal Enmity: The Spyrer gains the Hatred (X) Condition where X is the type of gang that took them Out of Action.
13Bitter Enmity: The Spyrer gains the Hatred (X) Condition where X is the gang that took them Out of Action.
14Personal Enmity: The Spyrer gains the Hatred (X) Condition where X is the model that took them Out of Action. If they were not taken Out of Action as a result of an enemy model’s action, treat this result as Bitter Enmity.
15Horrid Scars: The Spyrer gains the Fearsome Condition.
16Impressive Scars: The Spyrer increases their Leadership characteristic by 1.
21-26Superficial Damage: Despite being incapacitated, the Spyrer’s hunting rig successfully maintains all systems and preserves the Fighter inside. The Spyrer misses the rest of the battle, but suffers no long-term effects.
31-46Grievous Wound: The Spyrer goes into Recovery.
51Anxiety Suppression Damaged: The Spyrer goes into Recovery, increases their Glitch Count by 1, and reduces their Cool characteristic by 1.
52Neural Feedback: The Spyrer goes into Recovery, increases their Glitch Count by 1, and reduces their Intelligence characteristic by 1.
53Humbled: The Spyrer goes into Recovery, increases their Glitch Count by 1, and reduces their Leadership characteristic by 1.
54Vox Ghosts: The Spyrer goes into Recovery, increases their Glitch Count by 1, and reduces their Willpower characteristic by 1.
55Gyroscopic Destabilisation: The Spyrer goes into Recovery, increases their Glitch Count by 1, and reduces their Initiative characteristic by 1.
56Seized Locomotors: The Spyrer goes into Recovery, increases their Glitch Count by 1, and reduces their Movement characteristic by 1.
61Targeting Uplink Disruption: The Spyrer goes into Recovery, increases their Glitch Count by 1 and reduces their Ballistic Skill characteristic by 1.
62Stuttering Servos: The Spyrer goes into Recovery, increases their Glitch Count by 1 and reduces their Weapon Skill characteristic by 1.
63Damaged Musculature: The Spyrer goes into Recovery, increases their Glitch Count by 1 and reduces their Strength characteristic by 1.
64Reduced Plate Density: The Spyrer goes into Recovery, increases their Glitch Count by 1 and reduces their Toughness characteristic by 1.
65Multiple Glitches: Roll D3 times on this table, re-rolling any results of Multiple Glitches or Critical Overload.
66Critical Overload: The Spyrer is killed instantly – not even their hunting rig can save them. If the injury was caused by an enemy model, that model earns 1 extra XP.

SPYRER EQUIPMENT

PAIRED BOLT LAUNCHERS

Tier 1 Augmentation: Improve the Lethality characteristic to 2.

Tier 2 Augmentation: Improve the AP characteristic to -2.

Tier 3 Augmentation: Replace the Rapid Fire (2) trait with the Rapid Fire (3) trait.

PAIRED DISINTEGRATION MATRIX

Tier 1 Augmentation: Improve the AP characteristic to -3.

Tier 2 Augmentation: Replace the Ammo (5+) trait with the Ammo (4+) trait.

Tier 3 Augmentation: Improve the Lethality characteristic to 3.

JAKARA HUNTING RIG

Tier 1 Augmentation: Improve the wearer’s Strength characteristic by 1.

Tier 2 Augmentation: Improve the wearer’s Attacks characteristic by 1.

MALCADON HUNTING RIG

Tier 1 Augmentation: Improve either the wearer’s Ballistic Skill or Weapon Skill characteristic by 1.

Tier 2 Augmentation: Improve the wearer’s Save characteristic by 1.

GANG SPECIAL RULES

Claiming Bounties: If during the Receive Rewards step of the Post-battle Sequence a Venator gang has taken at least three enemy Fighters Out of Action during the battle, they add 20 credits to their Stash.

Starting Skills: When added to a Gang Roster, all Venator Leaders and Champions may select one skill from one of their Primary Skill Sets.

Skill Access: When creating a Venator gang, pick any four Skill Sets from the Necromunda Skirmish Core Rulebook. Rank them from 1 to 4, with 1 being the Skill Set that most embodies the way you envisage the band operating as a team. Each model’s access to Skill Sets is then determined by referring to the table below – this should be noted down separately:

FighterPrimarySecondary
Venator Hunt Leader1 and 23 and 4
Venator Hunt Champion1 and 23
Venator Specialist12 and 3

NEW SUBTYPE: OGRYN

All Ogryns are subject to the following rule:

Starting Skills: In addition to any other skills, all Ogryns have the Juggernaut skill.

NEW SUBTYPE: RATLING

All Ratlings are subject to the following rules:

Sniping: This Fighter may re-roll Hit rolls of a natural 1 when performing an Aimed Shot action.

Sneaking: This Fighter always counts as being in a weapon’s Long Range when calculating the bonus for cover.

NEW SUBTYPE: BEASTMAN

All Beastmen are subject to the following rule:

Feral Warriors: Beastmen Fighters increase their Attacks characteristic by 1 while they are Injured.

GANG LEGACY

Most Fighters in a Venator gang have access to a Gang Legacy as detailed in their Fighter datasheet. A Fighter with a Gang Legacy may purchase weapons and wargear from their gang’s Equipment List when added to a gang (they may not purchase additional weapons from this list during the Post-cycle Sequence):

Equipment List Cawdor House Cawdor Equipment List Delaque House Delaque Equipment List Escher House Escher Equipment List Goliath House Goliath Equipment List Orlock House Orlock Equipment List Van Saar House Van Saar Equipment List Ironhead Squat Ironhead Squat Equipment List Ogryn Free Ogryn Equipment List A Venator Hunt Leader or Venator Hunt Champion may purchase Pets associated with their Gang Legacy when added to a Gang Roster. For example, a Venator Hunt Leader with a Goliath Gang Legacy may purchase a Sumpkroc.

There is no restriction on different Gang Legacies within a gang – a Venator gang may contain as many or as few as you wish. However, each Fighter may only originate from one gang.
